ValidationRule.description: Open requests may only move forward one stage at a time (moving back or to Rejected is always allowed).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Rejected")), CASE(Status__c, "Submitted", 1, "Under Review", 2, "Documents Requested", 3, "Finance Approval", 4, "Approved", 5, 0) > CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), "Submitted", 1, "Under Review", 2, "Documents Requested", 3, "Finance Approval", 4, "Approved", 5, 0) + 1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Requests move one stage at a time: Submitted, Under Review, Documents Requested, Finance Approval, Approved.
